# T001.1 — Stabilize full-solution test gate (replacement)

## Summary

This is the replacement for T001 after the approved amendment corrected its validation metadata. The already implemented test gate, real web-targets bridge, and unchanged legacy application need no further source edits.

## Changes (files and why)

- `DescopeSampleApp.sln` — Existing T001 change includes the net48 characterization test project alongside the unchanged legacy project.
- `DescopeSampleApp.CharacterizationTests/DescopeSampleApp.CharacterizationTests.csproj` and `DescopeSampleApp.CharacterizationTests/TokenValidatorCharacterizationTests.cs` — Existing T001 net48 xUnit project has three offline tests pinning the observed legacy token-validation fallback.
- `Directory.Build.props` — Existing T001 bridge uses installed real BuildTools WebApplication targets when SDK MSBuild evaluates the legacy project; it does not replace the targets or modify legacy code.
- `.github/modernization/ff4c277d-ed6d-4227-b1d9-ea32d11afff4/progress/T001.md` — Existing T001 evidence and gate-blockage record.
- `.github/modernization/ff4c277d-ed6d-4227-b1d9-ea32d11afff4/progress/T001.1.md` — This replacement-task record.

## Decisions (rationale and sources)

The T001 progress note documents that both exact build and test gates passed, but completion was blocked because plan prose `none defined` was mistakenly stored as an executable lint command. The approved amendment replaced T001 with T001.1 using the same build and test commands and an empty lint gate. No fake lint command, validation bypass, legacy source edit, or reimplementation is needed. As documented in T001, all three different signed JWT inputs return false with the same diagnostic (`Error verifying token expiration: Value cannot be null.` followed by `Parameter name: value`); this does **not** prove that the expiration comparison works, or that a future-expiring token is accepted.

## Validation (commands and results)

- `msbuild -restore -p:RestorePackagesConfig=true -p:Configuration=Release -m -nologo -v:minimal` — PASS (exit 0), freshly run after creating this note; builds both legacy and test DLLs. Existing NU1902 jQuery advisories and MSB3247 binding conflict remain.
- `dotnet test --no-build -c Release` — PASS (exit 0), freshly run after creating this note: 3 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped in the net48 characterization assembly.
- Lint — no lint command defined; approved replacement gate is empty.

## Follow-ups and risks

- The real BuildTools web-targets path is runner-specific; a compatible installation is still required on other hosts.
- Existing jQuery advisory, binding conflict, unused variable warning, and unresolved legacy expiration failure remain out of scope. No claim is made that token expiration succeeds.
